visualCharacteristics.structure: bg image + character image + heading + text + CTA
visualCharacteristics.layout: coverflow: 3 cards visible, active center card enlarged; round arrows at sides
visualCharacteristics.notes: full-bleed blue/teal background art; cards with coral/red lower panel, white text; purple pill CTA on the active card; character art pops above card top

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns. Optional first row = a single image cell with no text (band background, decorative). Then one row per slide: Cell 1 = slide background art image followed by the character image (two images, background first); Cell 2 = H3 headline, description paragraph, and a final link-only paragraph (e.g. 'Learn More') rendered as a button. Slides scroll horizontally with snap; from 900px three cards show with the centered (active) card enlarged; prev/next buttons and arrow keys move between slides; no autoplay
